topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Master Harold came back from town sayin' his attic's holdin' more than just the chill o' winter. Seems the last fam'ly to live in the old place left behind their trinkets and whatnots. Harold's eyes lit up like the first glimpse of sun through the mornin' fog when he told us. He's thinkin' of sortin' through it all, seein' if there's something worth keepin' or makin' a bit o' coin from. I reckon it's a bit of good fortune, like findin' a forgotten sheaf in the field after the harvest. Might be the saints are smilin' down on us, guidin' us to a bit o' unexpected bounty.
